notes: The word temple on the Decks page is gone: it is the Word bank again, a number with how many of your words are proven. Proven words now earn pieces for a collection, the money of China in the order it was used (shell money, spade and knife coins, Ban Liang, Kaiyuan Tongbao, the Jiaozi note, silver and gold ingots, the dragon dollar) with gold badges at 100, 1,000 and 2,500. Each new piece is celebrated full screen, and the whole collection is on the word bank page
